text: Broker Amy Adams sends 84.3% of all referrals to Carlson Medical Centre - 107 claims worth $278,376 - and the clinic's transfers to this broker total $42,764 against an expected commission of about $24,613, an excess of roughly 6.5% of pair volume. Referral concentration alone can be an honest exclusive partnership, and Carlson takes only 8.4% of its claims from this broker, which softens the picture. What keeps the item alive is the money: transfers meaningfully above contractual commission need a reason. No shared ownership or shell routing was found for this pair, so the alert stays low. Next step: reconcile the transfer ledger against the commission agreement and ask what the surplus payments purchased.
